notes.title: About Localization
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I’d like to share some updates about the localization of "Inner Truth". 

My goal is to make this game accessible to as many people as possible.
However, as a solo developer with limited time and resources, I’ve decided to release the game first in Japanese, Chinese, and English, with plans to gradually add more languages over time.  

I’m sorry for any inconvenience this may cause and truly appreciate your understanding.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me anytime.

Thank you so much for your support!

- Miyoshi Shizuka
